rule.eligibility: at least 53% overall points against each anchor in color-balanced paired matches, with all native/parity checks passing
rule.selection: highest minimum point rate across the two anchors; then highest mean rate; then later generation
rule.confirmation: 400 fresh paired games against each anchor at the same d5/b256/256k envelope; do not pool with screening games
rule.promotion: require lower paired-bootstrap 95% bound above 50% against each anchor and at least 53% overall points; report color splits as diagnostics, plus clean replay, representative-game review, and a separate deployed-latency check
rule.colorRationale: Preregistered before any arena started. Balanced pairing controls first-player advantage. Above-50% in each color is not required: it can reject a stronger challenger when Light has an intrinsic advantage. Retain both color splits in every report.
